rows.note: Use 整靚 as the all-purpose colloquial way to make a person, object, or place look better.

example.english: I’ll beautify the flat a bit.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 gaan1 uk1 zing2 leng3 di1

rows.note: Use 打扮 when beautifying a person's appearance through clothes, hair, or styling.

example.english: I’ll beautify myself a bit before attending the wedding.
example.traditional: 我出席婚禮之前會打扮得靚啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 zik6 fan1 lai5 zi1 cin4 wui5 daa2 baan6 dak1 leng3 di1

rows.note: Use 裝飾 when beautifying a room, object, or setting by adding decorative features.

example.english: I’ll beautify the living room with fresh flowers.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sin1 faa1 zong1 sik1 go3 haak3 teng1

rows.note: Use 美化 for abstract or public-facing descriptions of improving an image, appearance, or environment.

example.english: The government says the new road will beautify the whole community.
example.traditional: 政府話條新路會美化成個社區。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 waa6 tiu4 san1 lou6 wui5 mei5 faa3 sing4 go3 se5 keoi1
